column1: # ZAP baseline rules for dev/zap/scan.sh: rule ID, action, name and reason, separated by tabs.
# A rule not listed here warns, and any warning fails the scan. INFO reports a rule without
# failing; IGNORE silences it. Change a rule only after review, and give the reason.

column4: Dynamic responses send no-store, which already forbids caching.
The return_to hidden input is a validated same-origin path escaped by Go html/template; FuzzReturnTo checks redirects.
Existing templates use inline scripts, event handlers and styles; CSP still restricts resource origins, framing and form targets.
Go CrossOriginProtection checks Sec-Fetch-Site and Origin on unsafe requests, including login; security_test.go covers direct and trusted-proxy requests.
